name: Northern Region Cement Company
summary: Northern Region Cement Company specializes in the production and distribution of various Portland cement types, serving both Saudi Arabia and The Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio, including white Portland cement for precast, structural, and architectural concrete, along with white Portland limestone cement specifically designed for decorative concrete products and tiles. Its range also features ordinary Portland cement, an essential material for pavements, floors, buildings, bridges, railway structures, warehouses, tanks, water pipes, and general construction units. For demanding conditions, they supply sulfate-resistant grey Portland cement, ideal for concrete exposed to high sulfur environments, as well as specialized oil well cement. Beyond these, their products support diverse applications such as fountains, swimming pools, and general concrete structural reinforcement. Established in 2006, Northern Region Cement Company is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
